routes.name: Temporary residency based on “major investment/major investment plan”
Macao SAR Permanent Resident Identity Card

note: Macao, read on 2026-10-30 on the Commerce and Investment Promotion Institute's (IPIM) pages on temporary residency under Administrative Regulation 3/2005 (Residency Regime for Investors, Management and Technical Personnel): its introduction, eligibility, important notes and its answer on seven years' residence. New applications are taken only for temporary residency based on a major investment or major investment plan (written as the means route); residency for management or technical personnel with special qualifications was abolished for new applicants by Law 7/2023 (arts. 32 and 38) and residency for investment in real estate has taken no new applicants since 4 April 2007, both kept only for renewals and family dependants, so neither is written. An approved applicant is granted a renewable temporary residency permit valid for a maximum of three years (a ceiling, so no term is written); a renewal is applied for within the first 60 days of the 90 before expiry. After residing in Macao for at least seven consecutive years the holder applies to IPIM for a Declaration of Confirmation and then to the Identification Bureau for the Permanent Resident Identity Card (7 written); IPIM adds that seven years don't bring permanent residency automatically. No fee, decision time, place of application or right to work is stated on these pages, and the permanent card's own conditions weren't read. The talent programme of Law 7/2023 and the non-resident worker's authorisation (the Labour Affairs Bureau's and the police's), the routes a performer would most likely use, weren't read: the Labour Affairs Bureau's site answered 403 and the Public Security Police's 500 on 2026-10-30.

sources.title: IPIM (Macao), Introduction of Application Guidelines
sources.said: Administrative Regulation No.3/2005 – Residency Regime for Investors, Management and Technical Personnel ... new application for temporary residency based on investment in local real estate allowed in Paragraph 4 under Article 1 of the Administrative Regulation has not been accepted since 4 April 2007, ... Pursuant to Articles 32 and 38 of Law No. 7/2023, new temporary residency application based on being “management personnel / technical personnel with special qualifications” as stipulated in Paragraph 3 under Article 1 of the Administrative Regulation is abolished,

sources.title: IPIM (Macao), Important notes about temporary residency applications
sources.said: interested parties will be granted a renewable temporary residency permit valid for a maximum of three years once the temporary residency application has been approved. ... applicants should submit to IPIM a renewal application within the first 60 days of the 90 days before the expiration of the temporary residency. ... must apply for a Declaration of Confirmation from IPIM before applying for the Macao SAR Permanent Resident Identity Card at the Identification Bureau after having resided in Macao SAR for at least seven consecutive years

sources.title: IPIM (Macao), Eligibility
sources.said: 1. Temporary residency based on “major investment/major investment plan” ... (only applications for renewal and family dependent extensions are allowed)

sources.title: IPIM (Macao), Living in Macao with temporary residency for 7 years
sources.said: people having lived in Macao for seven years after the temporary residency is first granted will not obtain permanent residency automatically.
